mechanism.base: The refined prevails over the stubborn, and so fire works metal: in the furnace the hardest thing in the world goes soft, gives up its rock, and takes a finer form. Cold, metal refuses every argument. Heated, it flows like consent, and the smith reads the glow the way farmers read the sky.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the forge stands cold: heat with nothing hard to work, charm with no asset under it. Your chart asks you to work metal. Take on the difficult, valuable thing.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the melting never stops: everything softened for reworking, nothing allowed to cool and keep an edge. Let finished things stay finished. A forge needs objects, not only fire.

function.definition_catalyst: Metal is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is your heat applied to hard, valuable problems: negotiations, difficult skills, work that resists until it yields. Easy tasks waste you.
function.definition_friction: Metal is your Action, and as a friction, it is reworking what should be finished: renegotiating settled things, polishing shipped work, effort spent softening what was already solid. Done is a decision you keep reopening.
function.advise_catalyst: Difficulty is your natural price filter, so use it openly. Take the assignment everyone else avoids. Price your work higher than feels comfortable and let the discomfort season. Once a year, pick one skill hard enough to embarrass you for months.
function.advise_friction: Finished things are load-bearing, so stop testing them. Close three open loops this week and do not reopen them. Give every task a final pass, then a lock. Aim the reworking energy at one genuinely unsolved problem instead.

candidates.cta_verdict: You act by forging, heat applied until something keeps its shape, and your money follows the finished piece rather than the bright idea.

__ore.retired_bonds_dip: You provide by making: the things you forge carry your warmth into other hands.
__ore.retired_fn_body: The Drive is your action function: what you go get, build, and hold. With Metal running it, action in you is smithing: you take hard, resistant, valuable material and work it while it is hot. Deals, crafts, reputations, all shaped in heat, all worth more when you set them down. Strike in the window. Your timing is the skill.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Fire, and Fire tames Metal: the forge softens the blade. Metal is the hard, finished, valuable material your heat exists to work: money, tools, standards, anything that resists until it glows. That is why Metal is your Action, the arena of what you build and claim. Value does not frighten you. You have seen what it looks like soft.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.order: What you forge becomes law: the tools you make end up setting the standards around you.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Metal is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is your heat applied to hard, valuable problems: negotiations, difficult skills, work that resists until it yields. Easy tasks waste you.

Energized by difficulty, bored by the rest. The gnarly client, the instrument nobody masters, the conversation everyone else postpones: these are where your focus arrives whole, and where the money and the meaning both live.

Difficulty is your natural price filter, so use it openly. Take the assignment everyone else avoids. Price your work higher than feels comfortable and let the discomfort season. Once a year, pick one skill hard enough to embarrass you for months.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Metal is your Action, and as a friction, it is reworking what should be finished: renegotiating settled things, polishing shipped work, effort spent softening what was already solid. Done is a decision you keep reopening.

Perfectionist heat with nowhere new to go. The sent email gets reread, the closed deal gets second-guessed, the finished piece gets one more pass that makes it different rather than better.

Finished things are load-bearing, so stop testing them. Close three open loops this week and do not reopen them. Give every task a final pass, then a lock. Aim the reworking energy at one genuinely unsolved problem instead.
